thesis: Eric Peters argues that Bitcoin is the most interesting macro trade he has seen in 30 years because it represents a new form of money that challenges the traditional power of governments to control currency. He initially believed governments would suppress Bitcoin because they do not shed power, but he has since changed his view as the asset has survived regulatory attempts.
